description: Look up a text segment in Pauhu TM: aligned human-translated paragraphs from primary EU law sources. Returns the best exact or fuzzy match (gamma score 0.0-1.0) + EU terminology for the segment. Each match traces to a real paragraph URL in the original source document. Designed for CAT tool integration: pass a segment, receive the TM match + terms as a sourced CAT assist.

domain.description: Optional domain hint for terminology disambiguation (e.g. 'data protection', 'financial', 'environmental')

text.description: Text segment to look up in the TM

name: pauhu_tm
title: Pauhu TM: aligned-segment lookup for CAT workflows
